guard: the connector performs repeated independent renewals over its own auth-service exchange and candidate mesh connection, adopting only proven newer credentials and failing loud without degrading to the old generation
why: The accelerated clock crosses two renewal points instantly and proves the connector, not a manager, owns the loop.
Candidate adoption is ordered before current credential replacement; a failed candidate is closed and the last adopted generation remains current.
There is no retry/static fallback or automatic mesh leave path.

mutations.name: connector replaces current creds before candidate adoption
mutations.replace:
current = next; // MUTANT anchor
      throw new Error("mutant replaced current before next renewal");
mutations.expectRed: two accelerated renewals connect and adopt before replacing current credentials
mutations.cell: two accelerated renewals connect and adopt before replacing current credentials

mutations.name: failed candidate is not closed
mutations.expectRed: candidate connect/adopt failure is loud, closes candidate, and preserves current creds
mutations.cell: candidate connect/adopt failure is loud, closes candidate, and preserves current creds
